items: The regional director asked Ms. Chen and ____ to prepare the quarterly sales forecast.
'Me' is part of the compound object of 'asked', so the object pronoun is required.
____ will inspect the renovated conference rooms before they reopen on Monday.
'They' is the subject of 'will inspect', so the subject pronoun is required.
The reimbursement form must be signed by the department head and ____.

Because ____ handles international accounts, Mr. Singh will attend the overseas client meeting.

'Us' is the indirect object of 'sent', so the object pronoun is required.
